capabilities: Narrow core Search to notes a trigram index cannot rule out
Keep a persistent index in IndexedDB that survives restarts and crashes
Preserve core Search's query syntax and exact results
Toggle narrowing on and off with the shouldNarrowSearch setting
Expose a typed search(query) API for other plugins
disambiguation: Not a separate search engine or search box; it only narrows which files core Search reads, leaving core's pane, syntax and results untouched.
extras: Documentation ships as a demo vault included with every release and browsable on GitHub; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Indexed Search keeps core Search and makes it fast.
motivation: The author wanted to keep core Search's pane, query language and exact results while making it fast, since existing fast search plugins answer in their own boxes with different results.
problem: Core Search has no index and reads every note on every query, which is slow on vaults of tens of thousands of notes, while fast third-party search plugins replace core's pane, syntax and results.

relations.evidence: its own fuzzy, ranked search box over a persistent index, with PDFs and OCR
its own search box over a worker-powered index, with typo-tolerant fuzzy matching
its own quick search with precise matching and frecency ranking
answers from the operating system's index (macOS Spotlight) in its own view
adds VS Code-like search controls to core Search

summary: Search accelerator that builds a trigram index in IndexedDB so core Search reads only candidate notes, returning core's exact results faster.
